what: the window crown is cut to the pinned profile, the window is really resized through the shell's own pointer drag, and the start window and the bar are compared as rendered images against the popit reference

authority.runtime_pads: OpenlockContour.pads() = clip 0.5, frame 1.5, stroke 1; plateInsets() reads OpenlockContour.band(h); no window file carries a contour number

rendered.ink: two crowns plus a 1px side rail each side (outline, never a slab)
rendered.fill: one surface, inset by the pin's stroke, paper 6% over ink #1c1d1e; active brass 16% over ink #29251e
rendered.bar_metrics: bar=1920x48 start=93 tab0=85 gap=5.6 windows=90 clock=109 tabs=3 startx=18 tab0x=117 gapExact=5.6

drag.window: 833x698 after a pointer drag of the south-east grip

resized.window: 1177x395 after a second pointer drag of the south-east grip at (622,642)

activated.window: 640x520 at (130,133) after the cell press restored it

window_crown_measured.arithmetic: the pinned 7.67x11.00 corner cut at frame_pad 1.5 is 7.67-3 = 4.67 -> 5 px across and 11-3 = 8 rows down; that is what every measured capture reads
window_crown_measured.note: the fill reads (27,26,22) on a fresh plate and up to (34,27,23) where the title wash sits over it; the sheet value is #1b1a16 and the ink is #b08d576b

bar_measured.hover_fill: unchanged from idle; the ink lights and the fill does not move

states.idle: closed: 5x8 chamfer, 1 px ink, the plate's fill, cut by pads() at frame pad 1.5
states.hover: closed: the bar's hover lights the ink only; the cell fill does not move
states.activated: closed: the active cell is brass 16 per cent over ink inside the outline, and the window restored at (130,133) keeps the 5x8 crown
states.drag: closed: a pointer press on the south-east grip now starts the drag (this client dispatches the press as onmouseactivate), and the window resized live from 640x520 to 833x698 with the crown re-cut at every step
states.resized: closed: a second pointer drag of the south-east grip resized the window again, through 1177x395 and 1072x380 to 815x348, and the crown at (622,642) is the same 5x8 with 1 px ink

next: nothing open in the crown; the pointer route works because the grips bind onmouseactivate, which is the event this client delivers

plate.authority: this build: .WindowTitle 36, .FormPopit .WindowButton 20x20, .ViewRowBox 22, .HasMeta 43.2; the reference renders the same shapes at its own --u

card.glyph: a drawn contour chip, 9x11, brass-lit; no codepoint in the chrome

application.rule: the silhouette is drawn on a surface inflated by the overhang and placed back over the host, so the frame lands on the host edge with both halves of its stroke inside the clip
